proof.interpretation: Eighteen exact drawn-layer frame records use a sufficient 3000 nm square-margin proof. The complete target union expanded by [-3000,3000] in both coordinates must fit within supplied areaid.ft for enclosure, or have zero positive-area overlap with supplied areaid.dt for spacing. Equality passes. No blanking or named-cell exception is applied. A failed square bound is unreviewed, not a foundry violation. Missing boundary context leaves a nonempty target unreviewed. Empty targets are recorded separately. Supplied markers do not establish complete-chip context. Generated masks, dummy diffusion, frame completeness and all other requirements remain separate.
proof.proof: No exemptions are subtracted: each published selected target is a subset of its complete drawn layer. A square dilation contains the Euclidean radius-3um dilation. Satisfying these stronger bounds proves the selected requirement; failure does not disprove an exempted or Euclidean-only case.
